name: incremental-graph
body: Feature incremental-graph (win C). At netbeans scale the DB build (parquet + copy_from + schema) is no longer negligible — it is a multi-minute floor. The ingestor must seed/splice the DB from the previous one instead of rebuilding it from scratch, while allowing a global projection pass over cached + re-emitted facts that never requires re-running the frontends. This is the part that must not be skipped on huge graphs.
